description: Replaces line-leading which checks with command -v in four scripts while a vendor copy and which inside echoed text stay. DISTILL-CANARY-e28ecbd5

trap_decoys.TR-DECOY: 请确认 which 命令可用

files.bin/部署.sh:
#!/bin/sh
which docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 1
which git >/dev/null || exit 2
echo "请确认 which 命令可用，whichever 版本都行"
echo "ready"

files.bin/README.md:
# bin

POSIX 里推荐用 command -v 检查命令是否存在：行首的 which xxx 改成 command -v xxx。
vendor-install.sh 是第三方脚本的拷贝，不改；echo 提示文字里出现的 which 只是文字。

turns.prompt: bin 下的脚本用 which 检查命令是否存在，不太可移植。把行首的 `which xxx` 换成 `command -v xxx`，例外看 bin/README.md，改完回复 DONE。
